name: kb_restoration_druid
notes: The Turtle knowledge base's restoration druid casts, added after role_healer: the max-rank Healing Touch emergency, Rejuvenation kept on the hurt, Regrowth on the tank, the rank-3 Rejuvenation blanket and Tranquility at ten hurt, and Innervate itself when the mana runs low. Entries run in band high, so they pre-empt the generic heal; the narrower conditions come first, which is the one departure from the KB's numeric order.

priorities.note: Moved ahead of the KB's order and in band emergency (not high): the KB puts it above the routine heals, and role_healer's own emergency rule would otherwise take the tick.
Tree Form is the preset's druid_caster strategy's business: it cancels the form above a heal.
Moved ahead of the single-target Rejuvenation: at three hurt the KB's blanket is the cast, and the conditions are all-must-hold. The rank is the KB's low-healing-power one.
The KB's rank 11 (highest) is the default; the rank-5-for-rogues concession is gear, not a condition.
The KB's ranks by target armor class (R9 melee, R4 casters) are not conditions; the highest known rank goes.
The KB's T3 2-piece trick: rank 1 on itself, mana back through the set bonus.
The Spirit-staff swap the KB asks for first is gear; 40% for 'about 600 Spirit' is the healer engine's mana-save threshold. The preset's druid_innervate keeps its own rule.
